entities.summary: Sergey Vasilyevich Malyutin was a Russian painter of fine crafts, (scenic) designer, illustrator and architect; initially associated with the Arts and Crafts Movement. Most of his oil paintings are portraits. Outside of Russia, he is perhaps best known for designing the first set of Matryoshka dolls, created by Vasily Zvyozdochkin in 1890. Sergey Malyutin was a architects & engineers from Moscow (1859-10-04, Moscow–1937-12-06). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
